## Duration analysis — frozen result

Snapshot and population
- Tracker snapshot: `6164b3954347d266799a0302aa3abf028e54b322` (analysis upper bound `2026-08-23T21:15:00Z`).
- Provider-contamination boundary: Gerrit 1494 / commit `c390cef54ac8abdc41808c16d18590d2430a1b3b`, merged `2026-08-07T12:34:40Z`.
- Primary rows are active, non-retired sidecars with the expected operation schema, positive finite `metrics.total_ms`, event timestamp at or after that fix and at or before the frozen upper bound, and `provider_provenance.ran_model` beginning with `bedrock:`. This keys attribution to the provider that actually ran, not configured intent.
- Plan schemas: `plan_review_result_v2`; completion schemas: `completion_verifier_pass_v1` and `completion_verifier_fail_v1`. PASS and non-PASS completed workflows are both included because an agent must wait for either outcome. Deterministic/no-model short circuits lacking `total_ms`, gate-error records, pre-fix records, missing-provenance records, and retired files are excluded. UUID dedup found no duplicates.
- Percentiles use Hyndman-Fan type 7 / NumPy default linear interpolation at index `(n-1)q`. Both cohorts are large enough for p99 to be meaningful (plan n=1,514; completion n=683).

Core workflow sidecar results
- Plan review: n=1,514, window `2026-08-11T04:03:19.722469Z` through `2026-08-23T21:13:17.854079Z`; PASS=993, BLOCK=518, INDETERMINATE=3. p50=189.332s (3.156m), p90=325.337s (5.422m), p99=443.163s (7.386m), max=1,311.462s (21.858m). Requested padded interval: 227.199s through 390.404s (3.787m through 6.507m), naturally worded as about 4-7 minutes.
- Completion verifier: n=683, window `2026-08-11T03:55:06.237980Z` through `2026-08-23T21:07:14.625939Z`; PASS=593, FAIL=90. p50=87.253s (1.454m), p90=155.830s (2.597m), p99=748.663s (12.478m), max=2,459.702s (40.995m). Requested padded interval: 104.703s through 186.996s (1.745m through 3.117m), naturally worded as about 2-3 minutes.

Sensitivity and outlier checks
- PASS-only plan: n=993, p50/p90/p99=159.750/281.469/394.153s. PASS-only completion: n=593, p50/p90/p99=83.815/143.289/499.358s. Including failed/blocking outcomes is the conservative and operationally relevant primary result.
- No clean row was sub-second. Plan max spent 1,305s in the LLM tier. The three 30-41 minute completion FAILs on ticket `cb91-1535-fe3a-47fc` spent 1,812-2,457s in the LLM tier despite only 2-7 requests; the 30-minute PASS on `e215-ab23-ed6a-4791` split about 834s LLM and 967s deterministic. These are real tails, not malformed values, so they remain included.
- Post-fix but provenance-missing sensitivity does not overturn the result: all-positive plan n=1,950 gives p50/p90/p99=180.347/319.832/440.180s; all-positive completion n=778 gives 88.340/171.927/709.101s.

Measurement boundary and user-visible plan command
- Source documents `total_ms` as wall time measured around `run_workflow` (`gate_dispatch.py` and `plan_review_recovery.py`). It excludes snapshot/context work before the timer and signing, sidecar persistence, and other work after the workflow.
- This project has `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets=true`. Plan review synchronously runs ticket-digest and overlap-judge work after signing and `REVIEW_RESULT` emission, so core `total_ms` understates visible `rebar review-plan` time.
- A conservative matched-log sensitivity paired one unique clean sidecar with the immediately following ticket-digest plus contiguous overlap-judge tail in non-shared worktree usage logs: n=282 across 57 worktrees, 2026-08-12 through 2026-08-23. Omitted post-sidecar tail p50/p90/p99=90.754/177.168/350.283s. Core plus that tail p50/p90/p99=330.248/488.088/621.329s (5.504/8.135/10.355m); max=1,008.354s. The requested padded interval is 396.298-585.706s (6.605-9.762m), naturally worded as about 7-10 minutes. Including the concurrency-prone shared main usage log gives a consistent sensitivity (n=495; padded 6.552-9.280m). This is an estimate, not durable end-to-end CLI telemetry: usage rows have no run or ticket id, matching is timestamp/sequence based, and preflight remains unmeasured.

`rebar metrics` evaluation
- The registry exposes only gate-economics `cost_per_accepted_change`, `env_diagnosis_intervals`, and `first_pass_verification`; it has no operation-duration metric or percentile. Independent sidecar extraction is therefore required. The current `sidecar_metrics.py` prose saying completion sidecars carry no metrics is stale after df94, but the duration payload itself is present and validated.

Recommendation pending operator confirmation
- Guidance should set the user-visible plan-review expectation to about 7-10 minutes, while optionally noting the core workflow is about 4-7 minutes.
- Guidance should set completion verification to about 2-3 minutes and explicitly warn that the observed p99 is about 12.5 minutes, so an occasional long run is not automatically hung.
- No repository or guidance file was modified.
